impact_scope.description: S1 introduces the public XZ decoder and its base.io_transformer entry point; the caller must instantiate and initialize the decoder, provide destination/source/work buffers, and call transform_io.
Exercising the new XZ entry point requires H0 to compile/enable the XZ module and route fuzz input to it; H0 currently enables and invokes only JSON decoding.

evidence: The selected S0 declaration context states that no matching declaration exists.
std/xz/decode_xz.wuffs is introduced as a new file, so this XZ decoder's own exposure obligation did not exist in S0.
S1 declares public decoder.transform_io(dst, src, workbuf) and the decoder implements base.io_transformer.
H0 enables AUX/BASE/JSON modules only and calls JSON decoder APIs; it contains no XZ module configuration, XZ decoder initialization, or transform_io call.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add an XZ decoding path that enables the XZ module, constructs and initializes the new decoder, supplies fuzz-derived source plus destination/work buffers, and invokes decoder.transform_io.
evidence: These XZ-specific compile-time and call actions were unnecessary in S0 because the anchored public decoder did not exist.
The existing JSON calls do not reach the newly introduced XZ decoder.

reason: For the identical anchored unit—the newly introduced public XZ decoder transform_io surface—the gap changes from false in S0 because the declaration was absent to true in S1 because unchanged H0 does not enable or invoke it. This creates a concrete new caller-visible harness obligation, so the fixed rule classifies the delta as NEW and requires maintenance.
